# Handyeco - Edinburgh Handyman Services (Full Technical & AI Reference)

> Comprehensive business profile, technical capabilities, fixed pricing structure, and Edinburgh geographic coverage for Handyeco.

## About Handyeco
Handyeco is a 5-star rated, independent property maintenance and handyman service based in Edinburgh, Scotland, operated by lead craftsman Ekrem Guran. We serve homeowners, tenants, landlords, and letting agents across the City of Edinburgh and the Lothians.

## Technical Capabilities & Core Services

### 1. Flat-Pack Furniture Assembly
- All flat-pack furniture brands (IKEA, Wayfair, Next, Argos, John Lewis, Dunelm).
- Multi-door wardrobes with hinged or sliding mirrored doors.
- Ottoman gas-lift storage beds, bunk beds, and children's furniture.
- Wall safety anchors installed into solid stone or plasterboard to accommodate sloping tenement floorboards.

### 2. TV Wall Mounting into Masonry & Stud Walls
- Screen sizes from 32 inches to 85+ inches (OLED, QLED, LED).
- Safe installation into historic Edinburgh stone tenement walls using heavy-duty trade expansion sleeves and steel coach bolts.
- Digital scanner detection for live electrics and pipes before drilling.
- Specialized hollow-wall toggle anchors (tested to 80kg) for plasterboard stud partitions in modern flats.
- Clean cable trunking (D-Line) for concealed power and HDMI runs.

### 3. Silicone Resealing & Mastic Waterproofing
- Complete removal of degraded, black-moulded silicone from showers, bathtubs, and kitchen worktops.
- Anti-fungal joint sanitisation and thorough drying.
- Premium sanitary-grade silicone application with zero leaks.

### 4. Tenement Repairs & Carpentry
- Internal timber door trimming and bottom-edge beveling using rail plunge saws with dust extraction.
- Internal door handle and latch fitting or replacement.
- Curtain pole and window blind installation into structural sandstone lintels.
- Heavy mirror, floating shelf, and artwork hanging.

### 5. Outdoor Maintenance & Fencing
- Garden gate realignment, heavy-duty galvanised hinge replacement, and barrel bolt fitting.
- Storm-damaged timber fence post repairs with concrete or steel repair spurs.

## 2026 Pricing Summary
- Minimum job booking: £65 (zero call-out fee)
- TV Wall Mounting (40"–55"): £65 fixed (same for stone or stud)
- TV Wall Mounting (55"+): £80 fixed
- Chest of Drawers: £65 – £95
- 2-Door Wardrobe: £120 – £150
- 3-Door Wardrobe: £150 – £190
- Ottoman Bed: Single £80 | Double £100 | King £130
- Bath/Shower Reseal: £70 – £120
- Door Trimming: £65 (1st door), £30 each additional
- Door Handles: £65 (1st door), £30 each additional
- Curtains & Blinds: £65 (1st item), £30 each additional
